body:
## [3.105.0] - 2026-11-05

### Features

- add support for payment method names in loyalty program and related components
- enhance loyalty program payment handling and add tests
- add opt-in continuous branch QR flow

### Bug Fixes

- preserve configured modes and generate one replacement QR
- stream full catalogs and isolate database diagnostics
- treat empty payment selections as unrestricted
- retain cached identifiers and pending QR confirmations

### Other Changes

- isolate product grid context from native storage
- .
- pin profile checks to the matching Visual Studio runner
- automate release documentation jobs and isolated lab profiles
- reduce payment-opening work and bound availability checks
- refresh API mock for scoped QR polling
